quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I would like to see ‘‘Dutch’’ and Johnnie brought together, Dut I am not prepared to wager $500 on the result.

notes: Allen's denial of the $500 backing; Niel's statement that he had been given to understand Allen would back him is his own claim. The paper dates the interview 'yesterday', so 1892-11-11.
